newsitem.title: USA: HealthSouth added to S&P 500, shares jump.
newsitem.headline: HealthSouth added to S&P 500, shares jump.

text.p: Shares of HealthSouth Rehabilitation Corp jumped after Standard & Poor's said it would add the rehabilitative healthcare company to the S&P 500 Index.
HealthSouth gained 3-1/8 to 40 in early morning trading and was one of the most active stocks on the New York Stock Exchange.
HealthSouth, now part of the S&P MidCap 400 Index, will replace Boatmen's Bancshares Inc on the S&P 500 Index after the close of trading on January 7, Standard & Poor's said.
Boatmen's Bancshares's deal to be acquired by NationsBank Corp is expected to close on that date.
HealthSouth will be replaced in the S&P MidCap 400 by Oxford Health Plans Inc.
